subject: Hosted API evaluation — follow-up & quickstart

Subject: Hosted API evaluation — follow-up & quickstart

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for taking the time to demo with us today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your team evaluating Hosted API fast: 

What we heard as priorities
- Low-friction eval: get an API key + sample endpoints to exercise your workflows
- Throughput awareness: you want to understand burst vs sustained QPS and how that maps to cost
- Data controls: need clarity on retention, encryption, and audit logs (you mentioned HIPAA sensitivity)
- Future path: possible move to Dedicated capacity if throughput & predictable latency are needed, or Private (VPC/on-prem) for strict compliance later

Hosted API evaluation plan (recommended)
1) Quickstart: we’ll share a short quickstart guide (attached) plus a temporary evaluation API key to call our managed endpoints.
2) Sample load: run a small traffic profile (10–50 concurrent requests) so we can validate latency and token cost for your prompt templates.
3) Monitoring: we’ll enable per-route latency & token breakdowns in the Console for the trial so you can see unit economics.
4) If you need higher throughput during evaluation, we can temporarily raise rate limits or discuss a short Dedicated trial.

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf (includes curl examples, SDK snippets, and recommended rate limits)

Next steps
- I can provision the trial API key and add your team to the Console today if you confirm the list of emails to include.
- Sean (cc’d) can run the technical onboarding and help size throughput during the trial.
- If you want, I’ll draft a lightweight SOW outlining a 30-day evaluation with success criteria.

Are you good with the above? If so, please reply with the primary engineers’ emails and any target qps/throughput numbers you want us to match.

Thanks,

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — follow-up & quickstart

Hi Olivia —

Thanks — copying answers below and a sample curl you can run immediately. I’ll be available for a 30–45 minute onboarding to walk through the Console and telemetry.

Default trial limits (can be raised on request)
- Default evaluation key: 10 requests/sec with a burst allowance up to 20 req/sec for short windows.
- Per-token throughput depends on model and sequence length; for the models we demo’d we typically see median p95 latency of ~150–250ms at 1–2k tokens for single-request calls under the hosted evaluation env.
- If you expect sustained 100 req/sec we recommend requesting a temporary limit increase — we can provision that for the trial window.

Data & compliance
- Hosted API: data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Default retention is 30 days for non-PII telemetry; we offer options to disable retention for customer payloads on request during evals.
- We can provide SOC 2 Type II summary and our standard BAA template. Private (VPC/on-prem) is the recommended path for full HIPAA-hosted requirements.

Regions & routing
- We can pin evaluation traffic to us-west endpoints to reduce latency. For production we support multi-region routing and smart failover.

Quickstart curl (replace <TRIAL_KEY> and <PROJECT_ID>):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TRIAL_KEY>" 
  -H "x-redwood-project: <PROJECT_ID>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.2", "input":"Summarize the following clinical note...", "max_tokens":1200}'

Increasing limits / Dedicated path
- For short-term evaluation increases we can raise burst & sustained limits within 24–48 hours.
- Dedicated capacity: ~4–6 week lead time from signed commitment for reserved pools; Dedicated gives predictable throughput and cost per token improvements.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): typically 6–8 weeks onboarding depending on network approvals and KMS integration.

I attached a lightweight SOW draft in case you want a formal eval plan and success criteria. I’ll hold time early next week for a 30-minute tech onboarding — propose Mon 02/23 or Tue 02/24 in the morning PST.

Regards,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
